entries.name: MiniSoftwareUpdate
entries.note: Background update checks and managed installs run in the updated agent, with pacman transactions guarded by a rollback. Gap: base-system upgrades are refused without a recoverable root snapshot, and no app gets a minimal update API.
entries.ready_note: Background update checks and managed pacman installs run in the updated agent with the shell rollback guard. The refusal of base-system upgrades without a recoverable snapshot is the guard's intended behaviour.

entries.name: MobileAccessoryUpdater

entries.name: MobileActivationMacOS

entries.name: MobileAsset
entries.note: Downloads on-demand asset packs for apps and the system. springboard/ui/src/managed_download.rs (queue, daily budget, three attempts) and assetpack.rs (manifest and pack state) are pure models that only the asset mock uses (ui/src/assetmock.rs); nothing runs the queue. Build a shell service that runs it, with the asset pack format.

entries.name: MobileAssetDaemon
entries.note: The background daemon behind on-demand assets (see MobileAsset). The managed download queue (springboard/ui/src/managed_download.rs) is a model with no runner. Build the daemon inside the update agent service set in springboard/updated.

entries.name: MobileAssetExclaveServices

entries.name: MobileAssetUpdater
entries.note: Could not classify: the reference index holds no binary for this bundle. The name suggests it applies asset updates; the download side is the gap recorded on MobileAsset.

entries.name: MobileContainerManager
